publication_edits: README links and publication status only; original local receipts and evidence remain unchanged. The machine-specific build-local.ps1 helper and compiled artifacts are omitted. Fresh GitHub build evidence is separate.
original_receipt_paths: The historical review-receipt.json retains paths relative to the original workspace. outputs/heat-grid maps to this study; outputs/heat-grid-lean maps to the sibling Lean package. Selected work/heat-grid sources map to reproduction/work/heat-grid.
reproduction: The public runner and 100 frozen inputs retain their bytes. reproduce.py copies them into a separate scratch workspace and normalizes Windows separators in the copied input manifest for Linux. A new simulation therefore creates its own input-manifest hash and receipt; it is not relabeled as the historical run.
scope: Threshold 1, breathing intervention peak 0.5/period 0.6, periodic domain and 384 fixed material quadrature points. Not a redefinition of the intended unforced underlying system. No fluid simulation is executed by the Lean workflow.
